labkit.dta.detectType

Detect the supported Gamry DTA family for one file.

Syntax

function [kind, status] = detectType(filepath)

Inputs

filepath
char/string path to one DTA file.

Output

kind
"chrono", "eis", "cvct", or "unknown".
status
struct with ok, message, kind, expectedKind, and filepath.

Related APIs

  • labkit.dta.detectPulses — Detect chrono pulse windows through the DTA facade.
  • labkit.dta.findFiles — Recursively collect Gamry DTA files without GUI side effects.
  • labkit.dta.getColumn — Return a table column by case-insensitive header name.
  • labkit.dta.getCurveXY — Return exact-name X/Y vectors from a parsed CV/CT curve.
  • labkit.dta.getMainCurve — Return the transient table containing T/Vf/Im data.
  • labkit.dta.getZCurve — Return the EIS ZCURVE table, or a compatible impedance table.
  • labkit.dta.loadFile — Load one supported DTA file without GUI side effects.
  • labkit.dta.loadFiles — Load multiple supported DTA files without GUI side effects.
